name: Ecarae Falei
source:
The Mask Ecarae Falei is typical seeming, among his brethren, in that his uncomfortable stares and slithering tone are commonplace for Masks. He works particularly close with former Mask Commander Mietwen, and has had many successful deployments in his increasingly prestigious career.
His current Mask Commander thinks he shows great potential as an assassin, though the truth is, his successful deployments were not always successful. Though he has hidden it well, he has, many times in the past, rearranged the terms of his deployments to better suit his personal needs... and he has, at times, avoided certain dangers, certain risks, that threaten his safety.

His mother is still alive, ashort-tempered former scout, retired after a leg injury, now a baker. He has a sister as well, but he sees neither her or their mother frequently. he lives alone. He is adept in poisons and finds the study of behavior and altered behavior fascinating.(from the in-game compendium).
